:::{#def-prediction-function-family}
#### Prediction function family (hypothesis class, hypothesis space)

A **prediction function family** $\predfam$
(also called a **hypothesis class** or a **hypothesis space**)
is a set of functions,
each of which maps a [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\predvar$ to a [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) of the outcome.

:::
